description: Split a series of sessions among attendees; use when sessions are recurring with varying attendees, not when splitting a single event among all players (use settle_up).

payments.description: Array of payment objects, each with payer, payee, and amount

players.description: Array of player names or IDs

sessions.description: Array of session objects, each with date, attendees, and cost

name: split_series

individualOwed.description: Amount each player owes after all settlements.

settlements.description: List of individual settlements between players.

amount.description: The amount of money to be transferred from 'from' to 'to'.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is specified.

from.description: The name of the player who owes money.

to.description: The name of the player who is owed money.

summary.description: Summary of the total amounts owed and paid.

totalCost.description: The total cost of all sessions.

totalOwed.description: The total amount still owed after payments.

totalPaid.description: The total amount paid by all players.

title: Split series
